name: Cossette Gipeldi
source:
[url=/c54026]Edgar's[/url] younger sister.
She's in love with [url=/c54024]Cain[/url], a willful and selfish lady.
She treats the protagonist like a rival because she is Cain's twin sister.

(CV.城玉 きな子)
